sources.entry: claude-code-zsh-completion by 1160054 - Zsh completion for the Claude Code CLI. Dynamically completes sessions, MCP servers, agents, models and plugins from the user's configuration.

summary.one_liner: A Zsh tab-completion script for the Claude Code CLI that completes commands, options, and names from the user's own setup such as sessions, MCP servers, agents, models, and plugins.
summary.what_it_does: Provides TAB completion after the `claude` command in Zsh, showing each command, subcommand, and option with a short description so users can build a command without opening --help. It also completes names drawn from the user's own configuration: sessions (by name or first prompt), MCP servers, agents, models, plugins, and background sessions. The README says the completions are available in 120 languages and regional variants, with each language as a separate file in completions/ (for example _claude.ja or _claude.de). Installation is possible through Homebrew, by downloading the _claude file into a directory on fpath, or through plugin managers such as zinit, antigen, or Oh My Zsh.
use_cases: Tab-complete Claude Code commands and options in Zsh
Resume a previous Claude Code session by name
Pick MCP servers, agents, or models without memorizing names
Get Claude Code CLI help inline while typing
Use Claude Code completions in a non-English language
how_to_run: curl -o ~/.zsh/completions/_claude <URL from README>  (URL omitted in README text)
notable: Completes names from the user's own setup (sessions, MCP servers, agents, models, plugins) rather than only static flags
Ships 120 language and regional variants as separate completion files
Works with zinit, antigen, and Oh My Zsh plugin loading
caveats: Zsh-only; the README describes no support for other shells
Non-Homebrew install requires manually editing ~/.zshrc fpath and may need a cache reset (rm -f ~/.zcompdump)
The curl download URL is missing from the README text provided
